prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 18 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1413; do not mention it.)
text:
Treatment Summary

The patient presented with acute cervical strain following a sideswipe collision that occurred while the patient was changing lanes. Symptoms at presentation included posterior neck pain rated moderate in severity, stiffness with restricted rotation to the right and left, intermittent headaches originating at the occipital region, and mild paresthesia into the upper trapezius without focal neurological deficit. Cervical range of motion was reduced by approximately one third in all planes, and paraspinal muscle tenderness was noted bilaterally.

Over the course of 18 visits, treatment consisted of manual therapy, soft tissue mobilization, progressive therapeutic exercise for cervical stabilization, and home exercise instruction. Modalities were used adjunctively for pain control as clinically indicated. The patient's pain and range of motion improved steadily, and headache frequency decreased substantially by the midpoint of care.

At discharge, the patient demonstrated near-full cervical range of motion with residual mild stiffness on end-range rotation. Pain was minimal with daily activities, and the patient was independent with the home program. No further skilled intervention is anticipated at this time. Follow-up on an as-needed basis is recommended should symptoms recur.
